- Credit on next invoice: fastest for AP, keeps cash in place; we will generate a credit memo that shows prorated subscription charge and VAT split. That credit will appear as its own line item and reference the original invoice/period.

1) Draft corrected mid-cycle invoice showing the prorated charge and VAT split (will attach PDF).
